summary:
26 items delivered (12 skill-stunts + 14 specialty), same shape as payload, same per-item field order. The 12 skill-stunt names are T-EXACT: I did not type them — the generator pulls each one out of `1-系统汉化插件/lang/cn.json` by its `ALIENRPG.Skill` and copies the value, so byte-equality is structural, not clerical. I verified the whole chain in source first: `module/data/actor-character.mjs:468` writes `skills[skl].description = game.i18n.localize(CONFIG.ALIENRPG.skills[skl].name)`, `templates/actor/character-skills.hbs:15` emits it as `data-pmbut`, `module/sheets/character-sheet.mjs:1119` feeds it to `game.items.getName()`. Names as written: 近战 · 指挥 · 通信科技 · 重型机械 · 操控 · 医疗 · 机动 · 侦察 · 驾驶 · 远程战斗 · 耐力 · 生存. The 14 specialty names are T-BILINGUAL (`中文 English`, one ASCII space) with the Chinese head pulled byte-equal from the matching `ALIENRPG.` lang value — every one of the 14 has a lang counterpart, because `config.mjs:342 career_list` labels them for the sheet dropdown. None of the 26 is in DO-NOT-TRANSLATE.json (checked all five T-FROZEN sections programmatically); nothing looks a specialty up by name, the dropdown stores the numeric id. `notes` is emitted as the literal `[object Object]` on all 26, untouched. The 12 descriptions get an explicit English-slug `id=` on the `

` per the uniform heading rule; `apply_translations.markup_signature` ignores attributes, so this costs nothing at the gate. Upstream's trailing double space before `` is preserved verbatim rather than tidied.

open_issues:
FLAGGED AS INSTRUCTED — Close Combat's heading is upstream test junk: `

Another test No Stunts Entered

`. I translated the visible sense without repairing it: `

另一个测试 未录入炫技

`. The 'another test' half is preserved so it still reads as junk. If the controller would rather this match the other 11 exactly, the fix is one line in the output file plus an upstream bug report — do not let it get silently normalised in a later pass, because then nobody knows the English was broken.

GATE COLLISION, needs a controller decision — `scan_missing_bilingual_tail.py` flags exactly the 12 T-EXACT names (0 of the 14 specialty names). It is not wrong about the shape: it puts `items.*.name` in its should-be-bilingual bucket. It is that it has no exemption for T-EXACT, which DO-NOT-TRANSLATE.json mandates be bare Chinese with no English tail. This is not a one-off: it will fire 12 permanent false positives on this pack in every future wave, and a gate with 12 known-ignorable hits stops being read. Suggested fix: have the gate load `DO-NOT-TRANSLATE.json.sections.exact_match_to_lang` and skip those 12 item names, counting them in its `excluded` tally so the coverage number stays honest (the runbook's own §5 methodology note: every gate must report what it covered, not just what it rejected).

The brief expected 'career descriptions' in the 14 specialty items. There are none — I checked compendium/en/alienrpg.alien-rpg-system.json directly and all 14 carry only `name` and `notes`; the payload is not truncated. All the real description content in this unit is the 12 skill-stunt placeholders. So SYS-I1's prose volume is far smaller than the 3497 raw_chars in index.json suggests (2595 chars across all English string values, of which 12 near-identical descriptions are the bulk).

TIER CHOICE I MADE, worth a controller confirmation — the 14 specialty names are T-BILINGUAL (`殖民海军陆战队 Colonial Marine`). Reasoning: DO-NOT-TRANSLATE.json does not list them in any T-FROZEN section; nothing looks a specialty up by name (config.mjs:342 career_list stores the numeric id, and the <select> matches on id); PROJECT.md §3.4 makes T-BILINGUAL the default for item names; and scan_missing_bilingual_tail.py's items.*.name bucket wants the tail. The consequence to be aware of: the character sheet will show the career dropdown label in bare Chinese (驾驶员) next to a specialty item named 驾驶员 Pilot. That divergence is by design — §3.4 gives `label` and `name` different tiers — but it is visible, so if the controller prefers pure Chinese here it is a one-line change in the generator and the T-EXACT half is unaffected.

TERM CONCERN, not changed by me — `Officer` is 飞行官 in BOTH lang/cn.json and glossary_alien.json, so I used it. But in Alien RPG the Officer career is the ship's command officer (Ripley is a Warrant Officer), and 飞行官 reads as 'flight officer', which collides with the separate Pilot career = 驾驶员. Two careers should not both read as the person flying the ship. Since both authorities agree, changing it is a ruling, not a translation call, and it would have to move lang/cn.json and every pack in one commit. Raising it now because the cost only goes up: `Roughneck` = 杂工 is thin for the same reason (an oil-rig/space-trucker archetype, not an odd-job worker) though less confusable.

SOURCE NOTE, no action needed today — translating `

No Stunts Entered

` is safe. There IS a `chatData.startsWith("

No Stunts Entered

")` comparison against the item description at character-sheet.mjs:1125 (and the same line in synthetic-sheet.mjs:1112, spacecraft-sheet.mjs:1090, vehicle-sheet.mjs:1013), but it is `&&`-gated behind `temp3.startsWith("
    ")`, which is the dead second leg the register documents: none of the 12 `ALIENRPG.` keys exists in lang/en.json. With Chinese names the dead leg gets deader still — `langStr.replace(/\s+/g,"")` now builds `ALIENRPG.近战`, which cannot ever collide with a real key. Per the register, do NOT create a cn.json block for those keys. If upstream ever restores them as
      stunt lists, this comparison goes live and the translated

      would suppress the fallback — cheap to catch then, worth a line in PROJECT.md §7.3 now.

The catch branch at character-sheet.mjs:1132 hardcodes the English `"

No Stunts Entered

"`, unlocalised. That is the failure surface the T-EXACT lock protects: if any of the 12 names ever drifts from lang, the player sees that English string with no error logged anywhere. It is also unfixable from a translation module — worth an upstream issue asking for `game.i18n.localize()` there, since the blast radius per the register includes spacecraft and vehicle sheets, which are UNGATED and run in evolved mode too.
